method: Curated semantic mutation probes. Each mutant removes one critical guard and is challenged by the same adversarial input as the real control.

probes.explanation: Mutant treats every authenticated principal as resource owner.
Mutant skips instruction-pattern and authority checks.
Mutant scores unavailable models instead of rejecting them.
Mutant interprets dry-run as a logging preference rather than an execution boundary.
Mutant accepts any schema-valid dependency graph.
Mutant ignores expected revision and accepts stale operator actions.

limitation: This is not exhaustive AST mutation testing. It measures six high-value security and correctness guards and must not be presented as whole-repository mutation coverage.
